answer: To change the currency used for your course, change your site's currency, as this applies to all paid transactions connected to your site. Go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click Language & Region, scroll down to Currency, use the drop-down menu to select your currency, and click Save. Important: To accept payments, your site's currency must match the currency in your payment provider account.

Wix Payments is only available in specific countries and currencies: Austria (EUR), Belgium (EUR), Brazil (BRL), Canada (CAD), Finland (EUR), Germany (EUR), Ireland (EUR), Italy (EUR), Lithuania (EUR), Netherlands (EUR), Portugal (EUR), Spain (EUR), Switzerland (CHF), United Kingdom (GBP), and United States (USD). If your region is not listed, Wix Payments will not be available and you will see locally available payment providers instead. Additionally, the currency set in your Wix account must match the currency in your payment provider account. To change your currency, go to Settings in your site's dashboard, click Language & Region, scroll to Currency, select your currency from the drop-down menu, and click Save. If Wix Payments is not available in your region, check your site's regional settings to ensure you receive all options available in your location.

If you see an element (like a logo) on your live site but not in the editor, it may be placed outside the site's gridlines or saved over. First, check your site history to locate the last saved version with the changes and restore it if needed. Make sure you're checking the correct page in the editor that corresponds to the live page. To locate an element visible on the live site but not in the editor, hold down Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) + Shift and press M to toggle through page elements until you reach the desired element. You can also use the Layers panel (Layers icon at the bottom of the editor) to find elements in the Header, Page, or Footer. Additionally, custom code can cause unexpected results, and site collaborators may have saved over your changes—check site history to view collaborator emails for each saved version. If the issue persists, follow the steps in the Wix Technical Assistant.

To see items customers added to their cart, go to Reports in your site's dashboard and view the Stores section. Use the Most Abandoned Products report to see which products visitors placed in a cart but didn't buy, or the Abandoned Carts Summary to study abandoned and recovered carts in detail (filterable by product gross value, customer type, etc.). To see how items were sold, use the Sales by Product Variant or Sales by Product Category reports in the Stores section, or go to All Reports and view the Sales section to use the Sales by item report, which gives a breakdown of specific items and services sold.

Since your site is published and not password protected, try these steps from the Wix documentation: 1) Verify your site is indexed by searching 'site:' followed by your domain (e.g., site:yourdomain.com) in Google. 2) Go to your SEO Dashboard > Go to SEO Settings and ensure the 'Let search engines index your site' toggle is enabled. 3) Check that individual pages allow indexing in the Editor (Pages & Menu > More Actions > SEO Basics) and that no 'noindex' robots meta tag is present. 4) Check for 301 redirects in the URL Redirect Manager and delete any that point to the missing page. 5) Reset the page's canonical tag to default in the Advanced SEO tab > Additional Tags. 6) Ensure the page has at least 250-400 words of content. 7) Add internal links to the page from other pages on your site. 8) Use the Wix SEO Setup Checklist to optimize and submit your site directly to Google. 9) Check the index status using Google's URL Inspection tool or the Wix Site Inspection tool. 10) Check Google Search Console for any manual actions against your page. 11) Request indexing for specific pages via the URL Inspection tool. Note that it can take time for Google to crawl and index changes, and search engines cannot guarantee every page will be indexed.

To connect your domain to a different website, go to Domains in your Wix account, scroll to the domain, click the Domain Actions icon and select Assign to a Different Site. Select the site you want to connect and click Next. If that site is currently connected to a different domain, choose an option: either Redirect it to the primary domain (redirect your domain to the site's existing primary domain) or Replace the current primary domain (connect your domain and disconnect the site's current domain). Then click Assign.

To rename a web link (menu item) in the Wix Editor: Click Pages and Menu on the left side of the Editor. Hover over the relevant menu item and click the More Actions icon. Choose Rename to change the name of the item on your site menu.

If your updated share image (og:image) is not appearing, first make sure you clicked Publish after making the change. Then, depending on the platform: For Facebook, go to the Facebook Debugger, enter your site URL, click Debug, then click 'Scrape Again' (or 'Fetch new information' for URLs never shared before) — you may need to click it multiple times. For LinkedIn, log in to the LinkedIn Post Inspector (https://www.linkedin.com/post-inspector/), enter your page URL, and note that it can take up to a week for LinkedIn to show the new image. Also verify your og:image has an aspect ratio of 1.91:1 (width 1.9x the height) to avoid cropping issues.

To connect Google Analytics 4 (GA4) with your Wix site: 1) Create a GA4 property in your Google Analytics account using the GA4 Setup Assistant (Admin > GA4 Setup Assistant > Get Started > Create property). 2) Copy your Measurement ID from the Web stream details. 3) In your Wix site's dashboard, go to Marketing Integrations, click View under Google Analytics, click the Show More icon in the top right, then click Edit. 4) Paste your GA4 Measurement ID in the pop-up (ensure no extra spaces), optionally select IP Anonymization, and click Save. Note: Universal Analytics properties stopped collecting data on July 1, 2023, so GA4 is now required for tracking.

The 'suspended by reseller' message means either your Google Workspace subscription has expired or there is a payment issue. To resolve it: 1) Go to the Business Email page in your Wix account to check the status. 2) If it has expired, click Renew Subscription. 3) If it is still active, go to Payment Methods, click Actions, then Update, click Next, update your card details, and click Update. Note: If you previously did not accept the Google Product Agreement and Terms of Service in your business email admin account, the email will also be suspended, in which case you must contact Wix Customer Care and may need to complete further verifications.

Here are the most common reasons a coupon (including a 50% off code) may not apply, and how to resolve them:

1. **Promo code link visibility**: If the "Enter a promo code" link is disabled on the Cart Page, or the link color blends with the background, customers can't see or click it. In the Editor, go to Pages & Menu > Store Pages > Cart Page (or the relevant Cart Page for your setup), click the Cart Page element > Settings > Settings tab, and ensure the "Promo code link" checkbox is selected. Then go to the Design tab > Links color box and choose a color that contrasts with the Cart Page background.

2. **Coupon is out-of-date**: If the coupon has start/end dates and the current date is outside that range, it won't work. Go to Coupons in your site's dashboard, optionally select "Expired" from the Status drop-down, select the coupon, edit the start or end dates, and click Save.

3. **Coupon is not activated**: If the coupon was deactivated, it won't be accepted. Go to Coupons in your dashboard, optionally select "Not active" from the Status drop-down, click the More Actions icon next to the coupon, and select Activate.

4. **Usage limit reached**: If the coupon has a total usage limit or a one-use-per-customer limit that has been reached, it won't apply. Go to Coupons in your dashboard, select the coupon, and either deselect the limitation checkbox to remove limits, or edit the total number of uses, then click Save.

5. **Extra blank space in the code**: If a customer types the code with an extra space (e.g., "SALE 50" instead of "SALE50"), it becomes invalid. Ask the customer to copy and paste the coupon code exactly without changes.

Note: Coupons are not case-sensitive. If the issue persists after checking these, contact Wix support.

To adjust the menu layout on your mobile site, open the mobile editor and click the menu icon, then click Edit Menu. You can adjust the layout in two ways: 1) Menu container layout: Click the menu container, then click the Layout icon to choose the alignment—Full Screen (opens to full screen), Left (opens to the left of the screen), or Right (opens to the right of the screen). 2) Menu items layout: Click the mobile menu items, then click the Layout icon to set how text is aligned (left, right, or center of the menu container) and how the submenu arrow is aligned (left or right of the item text).

To customize the layout of a Grid Gallery in Wix Stores: Go to the page in the editor containing the gallery, click the gallery, and then click the Settings icon. Click the Layout tab to customize the following options: General (toggle to stretch the gallery across the browser and set margin size; note that selecting Responsive under Grid behavior is recommended if stretched), Product grid (choose Fixed behavior so settings stay the same regardless of screen size, or Responsive so rows and columns adjust to screen size—this only works when the gallery is stretched to full width), Product images (select how uploaded images are displayed), Add to Cart button (choose placement; note that if placed on the image, the Quick View button won't display), Product info (choose a product card layout option), Product options (toggle to display only color options or limit the number of color options), and Ribbons (select where the ribbon appears and adjust padding).

If your automated emails triggered by form submissions are not sending, first verify the automation actually triggered by checking the automation statistics in your dashboard (Automations > hover over the automation > More Actions > View email stats). If it triggered but the email wasn't sent: 1) Check the recipient's spam folder and whitelist no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com and either @automations.ascendbywix.com (if no confirmed reply-to) or your confirmed reply-to email address. 2) Verify the recipient's email address is active and subscribed (look for a 'SUBSCRIBED' label on their contact card) and that the email address is valid. For form-specific issues: 3) Confirm the form was successfully submitted (check the submissions table). 4) Ensure the correct form is selected in the automation trigger settings. 5) Verify the form includes an email field (required for 'Send an email' actions) and that the field type is set to 'Email' / 'Email Field'. 6) Check that the form's email field is synced to your Contact List as either 'Email' or 'Email (Main)'. 7) Check if the contact has multiple email addresses, as automated emails may go to an additional email rather than the primary one; test while logged out of your Wix account to avoid merging test emails with your login. If the automation isn't triggering at all, check the trigger/filter configuration, any delays set, and whether 'Trigger once per person' is enabled.

Click the slideshow in the editor, then click the arrows next to the slide number to navigate to the relevant slide. Once you are on the slide you want to edit, click 'Change Slide Background' to select an image, video, color, or gradient for that slide.

If you are a sole proprietor in the UK and have a Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) number along with a business bank account, you should choose the Sole Proprietor (United Kingdom) account type. If you haven't registered for a UTR, or possess only a personal bank account, you can choose an Individual account instead.

According to the Google Ads with Wix refund policy, ad credits added to Google Ads with Wix are paid with a monthly subscription or a one-time payment, and these payments are non-refundable. If you pause a campaign, your remaining ad credits remain in your account and you can resume the campaign using those remaining credits at any time.

The Right Click Protect app is available from the Wix App Market and prevents visitors from downloading your site content via right-click. When a visitor right-clicks your content, they'll see a customizable message informing them that the content is copyrighted. To add it: go to your editor, click Add Apps (Wix Editor) or App Market (Studio Editor), search for 'Right Click Protect', click Add to Site, and optionally click Settings to edit the displayed message. Important limitation: this app does not prevent visitors from using Ctrl+C to copy your content.

According to the Wix Stores limits documentation, the platform limits are: Products: up to 50,000 products (uploaded manually or by CSV import); Product Options per Product: up to 6 (e.g., color, size, material); Choices per Product Option: up to 100 (e.g., Green, Blue); Product Variants: up to 1,000 variants per product. When you approach or exceed a limit, you receive a notification in the Wix Stores Dashboard, and exceeding a limit results in an error message. Additionally, general CMS collection field storage is limited to 500KB of data per item (excluding media/document fields), and free sites have CMS collection item quotas of 10,000 items (Wix Studio) or 1,000 items (non-Studio).

If you're receiving payments using the manual (offline) method, you must mark them as paid before they appear in your payments page. Go to Payments in your site's dashboard to view and manage your payments once they have been marked as paid.

To reinstall Wix Blog, first delete it: In the Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left, hover Blog Pages, click the Settings icon, then click Delete Blog and confirm. In Studio Editor, click the Pages icon, scroll to Blog Pages, hover and click More actions, then Delete Blog and confirm. Note that deleting does not permanently delete your content, but re-adding restores content without restoring settings or additional elements like Post List. To re-add the blog: In the Wix Editor or Studio Editor, click the Add Elements icon, click Blog, then click Add to Site (you will be asked whether to install with or without a Member's Area). Alternatively, go to the Wix App Market, search 'Wix Blog', select it, and click Add to Site. On the Wix mobile app, tap Manage, then Manage Apps, scroll to Content and Community, and tap Add next to Blog. Important: For loading issues on your live site, the documentation first recommends trying an Incognito/Private window and clearing your browser cache and cookies before reinstalling.

To add more menu titles to your site header, you have several options depending on your needs:

1. **Add new items to your existing site menu**: Go to your editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side, then click Add Menu Item at the bottom of the panel. You can add Links, Sections, or Dropdown titles. For a non-clickable dropdown title to organize items beneath it, click Add Menu Item, select Dropdown, enter the title, click Done, then drag relevant menu items into the new dropdown title.

2. **Add new pages**: When you add a new page via Pages & Menu > Add Page, a new menu item is automatically added to your site menu with the page name.

3. **Upgrade to an advanced menu** for more customization: Click Add Elements > Menu & Anchor, choose a menu type (horizontal recommended for advanced features), drag it to your page, then click the menu > Settings icon > Set as Advanced. Once set as advanced, click Manage Menu > + Add Menu Item to add Site Pages, Links, Sections, Anchors, Dropdown titles, or Mega menus.

4. **Reorder items**: In Manage Menu, click and drag menu items to your desired order in the header.

To track the status of a chargeback, go to Payments in your site's dashboard (your Wix Payments dashboard) and view the status shown next to the relevant payment. The possible chargeback statuses are: Action needed (you can still accept or dispute), Expires in "X" days (dispute window still open), Expired (dispute timeframe passed, final), Final (cannot be disputed), Accepted (funds remain with customer), Disputed (under review by the card/BNPL provider), Lost (dispute rejected, funds remain with customer), and Won (payment recognized as legitimate, funds and chargeback fee returned). Note: the Payment ID in your payments table is an internal Wix Payments reference only and is not linked to external processors/banks, so a bank-side chargeback number cannot be looked up directly in Wix; you track it via the corresponding payment in your Wix Payments dashboard.

To customize your Wix Store Product Page, access it via Pages & Menu > Store Pages > Product Page in the Editor, then click the Product Page element. 

**Layout & Image Display:** Click the **Layout** tab to select a layout, enable 'Stretch to full width', choose how thumbnails display under 'Show thumbnails', set the 'Image ratio', and select how images are resized (Crop to same size or Fit to maintain aspect ratio). You can also enable 'Zoom on image' for some layouts. Use 'Reset to original layout' to revert changes.

**Button Text:** Click the **Text** tab to edit button text for 'Add to Cart', 'Buy Now', 'Subscribe Now' (for subscriptions), and automatic states like 'Out of Stock' or 'Notify When Available'. Note: If you disabled a button in Settings, its text option won't appear.

**Additional Customization:** Use the **Settings** tab to show/hide elements (Add to Cart, Buy Now, wishlist, social share icons) and configure button behavior (success pop-up, side cart, cart page, or stay on page). Use the **Design** tab to customize colors, fonts, button styles, backgrounds, and product details alignment.

To access and remove the Google Maps element in your footer: 1) Open the Layers panel by clicking the Layers icon at the bottom of your editor, click 'Footer', find the Google Maps element in the list and click to select it. 2) If it's behind another element, right-click the element covering it, hover over 'Overlapping Items', and select the Google Maps element from the list. 3) If you still can't select it, check if your footer is frozen: click the footer, click the Settings icon, and disable the 'Freeze Footer' toggle. Once selected, you can delete the element.

To add new bank details to Wix Payments: Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to Wix Payments, then click Edit Account Details next to Account Details. Enter the new bank details under Bank Details and click Resubmit (or Save). Important: Whenever you make a change, Wix is required to verify your information, which can take up to 7 business days. During this time, you can accept payments through your site, but you cannot receive payouts to your bank account.

To customize the My Wishlist page (where customers view their favorited products), go to your editor and navigate to the page settings. In the Wix Editor: Click Pages and Menu on the left side, click Members Area, click the My Wishlist page, then click the My Wishlist page in the Editor, click Settings, and customize using the available options. In Editor X: Click Pages at the top, click Members Page, click the Member Menu, click Manage and Navigate, select My Wishlist, then click the My Wishlist page in the Editor, click Settings, and customize using the available options. You can optionally add an "Add to Cart" button to the page to make purchasing easier.

Your payments go from Wix Payments to your bank account via payouts. Each payment goes through 3 stages before reaching your bank: (1) Processing payment (usually 2-5 business days, including settlement and a pending period), (2) Scheduled payout (added to your next daily, weekly, or monthly payout based on your chosen schedule), and (3) Sent payout (sent from Wix Payments and arrives in your bank account within 3-5 business days). You can view previous and upcoming payouts, including which payments are related to each payout, in the Payouts section of your site's dashboard. To receive payouts, your Wix Payments account must be verified and Active, and there must be an available balance of at least $1.

A DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error means your browser cannot resolve the domain's DNS records. Since your domain is connected to Wix, follow these troubleshooting steps from the Wix domain assistant: 1) Make sure your site is published (click Publish in your editor). 2) Check that your Premium or Studio plan subscription is still active in Premium Subscriptions. 3) Verify your domain is assigned to the correct site in the Domains section of your Wix account. 4) Check your domain's status and expiry date using whois.com to ensure it is active. 5) If you connected via pointing, log in to your domain host account and verify your DNS records are set correctly: A Record (Host: @ or blank) should point to 185.230.63.107, and CNAME (Host: www) should point to pointing.wixdns.net. 6) If you recently changed DNS records or name servers, wait up to 48 hours for propagation to complete. 7) If you connected via name servers, ensure your domain host account has the correct Wix name servers. If issues persist after these checks, contact Wix Customer Care.

Go to Marketing Integrations in your site's dashboard. From there, find the integration you want to add (such as Google Analytics or Google Tag Manager), click Connect, and follow the instructions to complete setup.

Since you are receiving form submissions but the automation is not triggering, check the following based on Wix Automations troubleshooting: 1) View the automation's statistics in your dashboard to confirm whether it has triggered at all. 2) Edit the automation and verify the trigger configuration—specifically that the correct form is selected under 'Form submitted' (or 'Any' if intended) and that any filters are passing. 3) Check if the 'Trigger once per person' toggle is enabled, which would prevent repeat triggers for the same contact. 4) Check for any configured delay between trigger and action. 5) Ensure the form includes the required contact fields (email field for 'Send an email' actions; email or phone for workflow/label actions) and that the email field is the correct field type and synced to your Contact List (Email or Email (Main)). 6) Note that automations do not run retroactively—they only run for submissions that occur after the automation is activated. If testing while logged in, log out first, as logged-in submissions may merge contacts and affect delivery.

To resize your gallery in the desktop Wix Editor, click the gallery and drag the stretch handles on its edges to make it bigger or smaller. If the handles don't work, the gallery is likely set to full width—click the Stretch icon and disable the 'Stretch to full width' toggle to enable resizing with handles. Alternatively, you can use the Stretch icon to enable full-width mode and adjust the Margins slider (up to 80 pixels) to control side spacing.

To update the terms & conditions checkbox at checkout in Wix Stores: Go to Checkout settings in your site's dashboard. Click Policies. Select the checkbox next to the policy you want to display and enter the policy text. To make agreement mandatory, click the Policy agreement checkbox toggle to enable it. Optionally, select the Checked by default checkbox if you want the agreement checked by default.

Wix offers a 14-day, money-back guarantee for new Premium plans (including Premium Light). If you purchased your site plan within the last 14 days, you are eligible for a full refund. To receive the refund, cancel your site plan within the first 14 days of purchasing it; there is no need to submit a separate request. If eligible, your payment method will be refunded automatically, and you should allow up to 20 business days for the refund to appear on your credit card statement. After canceling within the 14-day window, your site plan is immediately deactivated and premium features (such as removing Wix ads or connecting your own domain) are no longer available. The 14-day refund policy does not apply to plan renewals or upgrades of an existing plan. If you do not meet the 14-day requirements but believe you deserve a refund, you can contact Wix to have your request reviewed.

To customize automated client emails (confirmation, cancellation, and reminders) in Wix Bookings: Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard, then click Emails & SMS notifications. Hover over the automation you want to customize and click Edit. For reminder emails only, you can also click Edit next to Timing to adjust when they are sent. Scroll down to Action 1 and choose what to customize: (1) Manage details to edit the Sender's name and Reply-to email address, or (2) Create an email to edit the email template—you can customize existing elements, add more elements, switch templates (note: this replaces existing changes), and for confirmation/cancellation emails optionally include a Calendar invite (ICS) file attachment. You can also set recipients (trigger contact and additional recipients). To add personalized dynamic values (variables) like client name or service details, click Edit under Create an email, then use + Dynamic Value in the subject line or + Add Dynamic Value in the email content, optionally entering fallback text. After editing, click Save & Continue, then Save. You can also use Preview & test to send yourself a test email.

Since you've already checked the automation statistics, continue with these steps: 1) Check the recipient's spam folder and whitelist no-reply@test.wixshoutout.com, or @automations.ascendbywix.com (if no confirmed reply-to) / your confirmed reply-to email address. 2) Verify the recipient's email address is active and subscribed (look for 'SUBSCRIBED' label on their contact card) - emails won't send to inactive contacts. 3) Confirm the recipient's email address is valid. 4) For form-specific issues: verify the form was successfully submitted (check submissions table), ensure the correct form is selected in the trigger settings, confirm the form includes an email field (required for 'Send an email' action), check the email field type is set to 'Email' (or 'Email Field' in old forms), and ensure the form's email field is synced to 'Email' or 'Email (Main)' in your Contact List. 5) Check if the contact has multiple email addresses - automated emails may go to an additional email rather than the primary one. Note: If you're logged into your Wix account while testing, your test email may merge with your account email under one contact, preventing expected delivery. Test while logged out.

To customize the cart page on mobile, you can decide where to display the checkout button for customers viewing your site on a mobile device. You can choose to display it only at the bottom of the page, or at both the top and the bottom. In the Wix Editor: 1) Click the 'Switch to mobile' icon at the top of the editor. 2) Click the Cart Page in the mobile Editor. 3) Click Settings. 4) Select a placement option for the checkout button. Note: In the Studio Editor, many customizations are available for the mobile breakpoint, but it is not possible to select where to display the Checkout button.

This is expected behavior: just as it takes search engines time to crawl and index new content, it also takes time for them to recognize that old URLs have changed or are no longer available, and the removal timeline depends entirely on each search engine. Since you have already submitted removal requests and your updated sitemap, the remaining steps are to (1) make sure your site is verified in Google Search Console so removal requests can be processed, (2) after each removal request, ask Google to crawl the page again by requesting indexing for that URL, and (3) allow time for Google to re-crawl and drop the old URLs from its index. If you have not verified your site with Google/Bing, you must simply wait for them to remove the pages on their own. Submitting your sitemap to Google and other relevant search engines can help speed up both indexing of the new site and removal of old site URLs.

To sell products on your Wix site, start by adding Wix Stores to your site (many templates include it, or you can add it from the App Market). Then build your catalog by creating products—you can sell physical or digital items, add up to 15 images/videos per product, and offer variants like sizes or colors. Next, connect at least one payment method (e.g., Wix Payments, PayPal, or credit/debit card providers) through the Accept Payments settings. Set up shipping by choosing regions and selecting rate types such as free shipping, flat rate, rate by weight, rate by price, local delivery, or store pickup. Configure tax rules for your region to comply with local laws. Once live, manage incoming orders, tracking, and inventory from your site's dashboard. Alternatively, if you don't need a full store, you can add PayPal Buy Now buttons to sell individual products directly.

In the New Automation Builder, you can add personalized content (dynamic values) to your automated emails when editing the email template. Go to Automations in your site's dashboard, create or edit an automation with 'Send an email' as the action, click the action to open the panel, and under 'Create an email' choose Edit. From there you can add personalized content to the email—these are dynamic values/variables that display different information to each recipient based on their data, such as their name (e.g., 'Hi David...'). Note that personalized content does not appear in test emails, but recipients will see it when the automation is sent.

To resolve a site unable to provide a secure connection (SSL/HTTPS issue), follow these steps: 1) Verify your DNS records are correct for your domain connection method (name servers, pointing, or Wix-purchased domain) - ensure default A and CNAME records are set in your Wix account or correct values are set at your domain host. 2) Wait up to 48 hours for domain propagation if you recently updated DNS records. 3) If you purchased your domain outside of Wix, ensure DNSSEC is not signed (check with your domain host). 4) Check any HTML elements on your site contain only HTTPS code (not HTTP) - edit the code in your Editor and republish. 5) Ensure your device's operating system is updated, as older OS versions may fail to recognize modern SSL certificates. If the issue persists after these steps, submit a ticket with Wix Customer Care.

To set one og:image for your entire site: Open your site's settings, click Website settings, scroll down to General social image and click Upload Image, select an image or upload a new one, click Choose File to add it, click Save at the top of the dashboard, then publish your site. According to the documentation, og:image is used by social networks such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, and LinkedIn to display the image when a page is shared. The provided documentation does not specify whether or how the og:image affects links shared in email.

To customize automated client emails (confirmation, cancellation, reminders) in Wix Bookings: Go to Booking Settings in your site's dashboard, click Emails & SMS notifications, hover over the automation you want to customize, and click Edit. For reminder emails, you can also click Edit next to Timing to adjust when they send. Scroll to Action 1 and choose what to customize: under Manage details, edit the sender's name and reply-to email; under Create an email, click Edit to modify the email template (add text, images, videos, or switch templates), and for confirmation/cancellation emails you can select the Calendar invite file (ICS) checkbox to include booking details. You can also add dynamic values (variables) to the subject line and email content by clicking + Dynamic Value and selecting from the drop-down, with optional fallback text. Finally, set recipients and click Save. You can preview and test the email before saving.

To download your website visit (traffic) reports: Go to All Reports in your site's dashboard (under Analytics), select the traffic report you want (such as Traffic over time, which allows you to analyze traffic over different time periods), click the Download drop-down at the top right, and select a file format (Excel, CSV, or Image). Note: The provided documentation details choosing a report time period (e.g., last 7 days, last 30 days) when subscribing to a report, but does not explicitly describe setting a custom date range like December 15 to January 15 for a one-time download.

To find the Address section in a room: Go to your site's dashboard, click the Hotels tab on the left, then click the Rooms tab. Click the Edit icon for an existing room type (or Create New to add a new one), then scroll down to the Address section. Click the 'Show map location' toggle to enable the address option, then enter the city, state, country, street address, and zip code. Important: You can only add an address to a room after you've set up your hotel. If you're adding your first room and can't find the address section, add the room without the address first, then come back to add the address after setting up your hotel.

To temporarily remove the Quick Action Bar from your mobile site, right-click it in the mobile Editor and select Delete. Note that when you remove the QAB, it removes the details you entered for each action, so if you re-add it later you will need to manually enter the relevant information again.

To change the header background to black when scrolling: Select the header, click the Open Inspector icon at the top right of the editor, then under Design enable the 'Color while scrolling' toggle. Click the color box to choose black (and optionally drag the slider to adjust opacity).

To create a custom sign-up form linked to your Members Area: 1) Make sure you have a Members Area on your site. 2) In the Wix Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left side and select Signup & Login (in Studio Editor, click Pages, then Signup). 3) Click Member Signup Form (Default) [or Signup (Default) in Studio]. 4) From the drop-down under 'Which member signup form do your visitors see?', choose Custom Form. 5) Click Add to Site. 6) Click any element on the form to customize fields, design, button text, and email notification settings. Note: Social login buttons (Facebook/Google) are not available on custom signup forms; use the default signup form if you need social logins.

You can customize your Wix Bookings form in several ways. (1) Set up your default Booking Form: go to Booking Form in your site's dashboard, give it a title, optionally add a subtitle, choose whether the Name field is split into first/last or combined, edit field labels, mark fields as required, and click + Add custom field to add Short answer (30 chars), Paragraph (255 chars), or Checkbox (500 chars) fields, then click Save Form. (2) Create a custom form for a specific service: go to Booking Services, create or edit a service, expand Additional Settings, click Custom booking form, title it, add/remove fields, and Save Form. (3) Customize the design: in the Wix Editor (or Studio Editor), go to the Booking form page under Bookings Pages, click the Booking form element, click Settings, then customize Layout (title alignment/spacing), Display (video conferencing badge, default payment options), Design (General Style, Form Field Style, Text, Button), and Text. Client responses appear in your confirmation email, calendar appointment, participant list, contact card, and the Wix mobile app.

To keep Square as your only payment processor, disconnect the other payment providers so they no longer appear on your checkout page. Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, click Manage next to each payment provider you want to remove, and click Disconnect. Note that disconnecting removes the provider from your checkout but does not close your account with that provider. If you prefer to keep the provider connected but temporarily hide it from checkout, you can instead disable it by clicking Manage and toggling off the payment method (this changes the status to 'Not accepting payments'). Make sure Square remains connected and enabled.

Use Wix Stores' built-in custom text field on the Product Page. In your site's dashboard, go to Products, select the shirt product (or click New Product), scroll down and click Add Custom Text Field. Enter the field title (e.g. "What name should we engrave?"), set the character limit, and select/deselect the Mandatory field checkbox (selected = customer must fill it in; deselected = can be left blank). Optionally click Add Another to add a second field (up to 2 fields total), then click Save. After a customer orders, the text they entered appears in the Orders tab.

To add a subscribe form to your Wix site:

**In the Wix Editor:**
1. Go to your editor and click **Add Elements** on the left side.
2. Click **Contact & Forms**.
3. Scroll down to the **Subscribe** section and drag a form onto your site.
4. Click **Settings** to customize the form using the available options (Layout, Design, Manage, etc.).

**In Wix ADI:**
1. Click **Add** on the top bar, then click **Section to Page**.
2. Click **Subscribe** and select the layout you want to use.

**To add a subscribe form to your footer** (so it appears on all pages):
1. Click the footer in the ADI builder.
2. Select the checkbox next to **Subscribe** on the left.

Once visitors fill out the form, they are automatically added to your contact list with a 'Subscriber' label.

To test orders in Wix Stores, you can preview the checkout process by placing a test order. Only the site owner can do this (not Admins or other roles). Steps: 1) Enable the manual payment method so you won't be charged. If your site has a Premium or Studio plan, either temporarily unassign the plan or duplicate your site and test on the duplicate. 2) If your site doesn't have a Members Area, add it. 3) Log in to your Wix account and open your live site. 4) Log in to your site using the Members Area. 5) Navigate to a Shop page, add a product to your cart, and click Checkout. 6) Click 'I just want to place a test order' and complete the checkout process. Note: You cannot preview checkout for product subscriptions. If you use a payment method other than manual payment, you will be charged for the transaction. To remove test orders from sales reports later, cancel the order in the Orders tab; canceled orders are removed from Sales reports after about one hour.

To refund a recurring payment made through Wix Payments: On desktop, go to Payments in your site's dashboard, click on the specific payment to refund, click Refund, enter the amount (you can issue a full or partial refund) and an optional note, then click Refund. On the Wix mobile app, go to Payments, tap the payment, tap Refund, optionally add a note, enter the amount, tap Issue Refund, and tap Issue Refund again to confirm. Refunds typically take 3-5 business days to reach your customer's credit card or bank account. Once initiated, a refund cannot be canceled or reversed. If you issue a partial refund, you can refund the remaining balance at a later time.

Copy the home page from your copy site, paste it into your current site, then set it as the homepage. Steps per the docs: (1) In the copy site's Editor, click Pages & Menu on the left, right-click the home page and click Copy. (2) Open the Editor of your current site and paste the page by right-clicking anywhere and selecting Paste (or Paste & Apply Site Theme to apply the target site's colors/fonts); the pasted page is added as a main page to the Site Menu. (3) In Pages & Menu, hover over the pasted page, click the More Actions icon, and choose Set as Homepage. Note: if you want to delete the current homepage afterward, you must first set another page as the homepage.

To transfer your Wix domain to another host: 1) Go to Domains in your Wix account. 2) Click the Domain Actions icon next to the relevant domain and select 'Transfer away from Wix'. 3) Review the info, click 'Transfer Domain', then click 'I Still Want to Transfer'. 4) Wix will send a transfer authorization code (EPP code) to your domain's registrant contact email. 5) Provide the EPP code to your new domain host and follow their instructions to complete the transfer. Note: Your Wix site will be disconnected once transferred, the process can take up to 7 days, and you cannot transfer within 60 days of purchase or after changing registrant contact info (which locks the domain for 60 days). Business email will stop working after transfer unless you re-add MX records at the new host.
To unfreeze your header: Click the header, click the Settings icon, then select a scroll setting other than Freeze (such as 'Scrolls with site', 'Disappears', or 'Fades out').

To update the picture (og:image) that appears when sharing your site link in the Wix Editor:

For a specific page:
1. Click Pages & Menu on the left Editor menu
2. Click the relevant page
3. Click More Actions
4. Select Social share
5. Click Upload Image, then select an image or click + Upload Media to upload a new one
6. Click Add to Page
7. Publish your site

For the whole site (one image for all pages):
1. Open your site's settings and click Website settings
2. Scroll down to General social image and click Upload Image
3. Select an image or click + Upload Media to upload a new one
4. Click Choose File to add it
5. Click Save at the top of the dashboard
6. Publish your site

Note: Og:images should have an aspect ratio of 1.91:1 (width 1.9x the height) to avoid cropping issues.

Yes, you can change your billing cycle from a 2-year (multi-year) plan to monthly. Important: If you switch to a shorter plan cycle, your billing cycle will switch over on the date when your current cycle ends (it does not take effect immediately). To change your subscription period: 1) Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account. 2) Click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan. 3) Click Change Billing Cycle. 4) Select your new billing cycle (monthly). 5) Click Continue. 6) Review your billing information and click Confirm.

You can create as many sites as you need within your Wix account. There is no fixed limit on the number of sites you can have; you can create as many as you want to manage multiple businesses, separate projects, or experiment with different designs. Note that if you reach the limit of free sites allowed in your account, you can move old sites to trash or upgrade sites to Premium (Premium plans are valid for a single site only). In Wix Studio, you can create as many sites as you want within each workspace (the limit of 50 applies to the number of workspaces you can belong to, not sites).

To set up a policy agreement checkbox during checkout in Wix Stores: 1) Go to Checkout settings in your site's dashboard. 2) Click Policies (or go to Customize your checkout > Policies). 3) Select the checkbox next to the policies you want to display and enter the policy text. 4) Click the Policy agreement checkbox toggle to enable it, which makes it mandatory for customers to agree to the policies before completing checkout. 5) (Optional) Select the Checked by default checkbox if you want the agreement checkbox to be pre-checked.

You can unpublish your site either from the Wix Editor or from your site's dashboard:

**From the Wix Editor:**
1. Open your site in the Wix Editor
2. Select 'Site' in the top toolbar
3. Click 'Unpublish Site'
4. Select 'Unpublish' in the dashboard window
5. Click 'Unpublish' in the pop-up to confirm

**From your site's dashboard:**
1. Go to Settings in your site's dashboard
2. Click 'Website settings'
3. Click 'Unpublish' at the top of the page
4. Click 'Unpublish' in the pop-up to confirm

Important notes: Unpublishing does not cancel your domain or Premium plan. You can republish at any time by clicking 'Publish' at the top right of the editor. Unpublishing is only possible on desktop. Once unpublished, visitors will see a 'Page Not Found' error even with the direct URL. If unpublished for more than a few days, your SEO ranking may be affected.

To view invoices you've created for your customers: Go to Invoices in your site's dashboard. You'll see an overview of payments made, outstanding and overdue amounts, followed by a list of all invoices you've created, each with a status (Draft, Sent, Viewed, Paid, Partial, In Process, Overdue, or Void). You can filter, search, and sort this list to find specific invoices. To view invoices for payments you made to Wix (e.g., for site plans and Wix services): Go to the Billing History page in your Wix account, where you can browse all payments, use filters and search to find specific charges, and export your billing history.

Payouts are placed on hold when there is a failed payout or an unresolved verification issue blocking the transfer. The held amount includes the failed payout plus any other available funds that cannot be sent to your bank. To resolve this, click on the payout in your Wix Payments dashboard to see the specific reason for the failure and the instructions to fix it. Common causes include incorrect bank account details (the bank account holder's name must match the Wix Payments account owner) or the bank account not being able to receive EFT/ACH transfers. Once the issue is identified and resolved, the funds will be added to your next scheduled payout. Note that if your site is unpublished, you must also publish your site and upgrade to a Wix Premium or Studio plan to accept payments.

To check which PayPal account is connected to your site, go to Accept Payments on your site's dashboard, click Manage next to PayPal, and view your current provider credentials in the Account information section. To see where a specific payment went, go to Payments in your site's dashboard; in the All payments section, each transaction lists the Payment method used, and you can filter by Payment provider. Click any payment to view more details, including the payment provider that processed it.

Go to Payments in your site's dashboard. From there, click on the specific payment you wish to refund, then click Refund. Enter the amount to refund and a note (if needed), then click Refund again to confirm. This works for payments made through Wix Payments on both desktop and the Wix mobile app.

To enable guest checkout for your pricing plans: 1) Go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site's dashboard (or go to Settings, then click Pricing Plans Settings). 2) Click the Checkout tab at the top. 3) Enable the Guest Checkout toggle to let people buy a plan without signing up or logging in. 4) Click Save. Note: Guest checkout is only available on the Plans & Pricing page, and it is not available for plans that include online content and services—visitors must create a member profile to access those benefits.

Documents may be rejected for several specific reasons. For Photo ID: it must be active/non-expired, in color, show all 4 borders/corners, not be blurry/overexposed/copied from a screenshot, not be angled/rotated, and your first/middle/last name and birth date in your Wix Payments account must exactly match the ID. For passports, the MRZ must be visible; for driver's licenses/ID cards, send separate files for each side. For Address Verification: the document must be clear, dated within the last 6 months, show the full name and address, and be a complete page (not partial). For Bank Details (statement/voided check/letter): the document must be clear, not blurry/torn/rotated/upside-down, not a mobile screenshot, show the full account number, have the bank logo visible, be issued within the last 12 months, and the account holder name must match your Wix Payments account owner (personal) or legal business name (business). Voided checks must have 'VOID' printed, be bank-printed (not handwritten), and not be part of a direct deposit form. For Company Details: the tax ID/registration number and company name must be visible and match your Wix Payments account details, and the document must be issued within the last 12 months. All documents must be in HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, or PNG format, max 10 MB, min 1 KB (PDF) or 100 KB (other formats). Documents must be issued in the same country as your selected business location. If 7 business days have passed and you've verified all information matches, contact Wix Customer Care.

According to the Wix Payments service fees documentation for Canada: Credit/Debit Card (excluding American Express) is 2.9% of the transaction amount + 0.30 CAD, and Apple Pay (excluding American Express) is 2.9% of the transaction amount + 0.30 CAD. American Express (including use with Apple Pay) is 3.5% + 0.30 CAD. The retrieved documentation does not specify PayPal transaction fees for Canada (PayPal fees are only listed for the United States at 3.49% + 0.49 USD).

The Wix Payments verification process may take up to 7 business days. You should allow 7 business days for your account to be verified. If 7 business days have already passed and you've confirmed your information is correct and matches your bank account details, you should contact Wix Customer Care for further investigation.

You can find a Wix Professional (certified freelancers and agencies) to help redesign and update your website through the Wix Marketplace. You have two options: 1) Submit a project request by signing in to your Wix account, going to your projects page in the Wix Marketplace, clicking 'New Project' and selecting 'Find me a professional' - Wix will match you with suitable professionals based on your needs, and you'll hear back within 1 business day. 2) Search for professionals directly by clicking 'New Project' and selecting 'Explore professionals', where you can filter by service (including Web Design), price, location, and language, view profiles, and contact them directly to get a quote. Wix Professionals offer web design services to get your Wix site looking exactly the way you want.

To create an automation for a standard Wix form: Go to Automations in your site's dashboard, click + New Automation, then + Start from Scratch (or search for a suggested automation). Name your automation, then in the Trigger section click Wix Forms (blue icon for new forms) and select 'Form submitted' (or 'Option chosen on a form'). Choose whether Any form or Specific form(s) trigger it, set the Limit frequency, optionally add a delay or condition, choose an action (e.g., Send an email, Send a chat message, Create a task), then click Activate.

You can offer free shipping when customers spend above a certain amount by editing an existing shipping rule. Set up a Flat Rate, Rate by Weight, Rate by Product, or Rate by Order Price rule, then select the checkbox labeled 'Offer free shipping when a customer buys over a certain amount' (or 'Offer Free Shipping on orders above a specific subtotal') and enter the minimum order price that qualifies for free shipping. Note that you'll need to set this up for every relevant shipping region, and if you create additional shipping services (e.g., Express Shipping), you must select the checkbox and amount for each service. Alternatively, for a temporary offer, you can create a Free Shipping coupon and set a Minimum order subtotal under 'Apply to'.

According to Wix documentation, once a payout status is 'Sent', the funds should arrive in your bank account within 3-5 business days. Since it has only been 4 days, your payout is still within the expected arrival window. Factors such as the day of the week, the currency, or bank holidays can affect the exact arrival date. If the payout does not arrive after 5 business days, or if the status changes to 'Failed', you should check your Payouts dashboard for details.

Hamburger menus are available in the desktop Wix Editor but not in the mobile Editor. To add one: Click Add Elements on the left side of the editor, select Menu & Anchor, then click Hamburger Menus. Click and drag your chosen menu icon to the page. If you don't see the Hamburger Menus option, ensure you are using the desktop editor (not the mobile editor), as hamburger menus cannot be added in the mobile Editor and any added on desktop are not transferred to the mobile version of your site.

If you recently changed your bank details, Wix is required to re-verify the information: your account status temporarily returns to 'Accepting Payments' and you cannot receive payouts until verification completes, which can take up to 7 business days (accumulated payouts are released afterward). Since 'a couple of weeks' exceeds 7 business days, the delay is likely not just routine re-verification. Check for a failed payout: in your Wix Payments dashboard, click the failed payout (or Payouts on Hold) to see the specific issue. Common causes are incorrect bank account details or a mismatch between the bank account holder's name and the Wix Payments account owner. To fix: go to Accept Payments > Manage next to Wix Payments > Edit Account Details, verify/correct the Bank Details, and click Resubmit; also confirm with your bank that the account can receive EFT (ACH in the US). For an individual account, also confirm your name/DOB match your photo ID and that you entered the bank account number correctly. If 7 business days have passed, the details are correct and match your bank account, and payouts are still not arriving, contact Wix Customer Care to investigate.

If your Wix Email Marketing campaigns are being marked as spam or not received, the most likely reason is that they are caught in the recipient's spam folder (which still shows as 'delivered' in your dashboard). Ask subscribers to check their spam filters, add your 'From' email address to their contact lists, check their webmail provider rules, and allow up to 24 hours for delivery. To improve deliverability, review the three main factors: (1) Sender Reputation - build it over time through positive subscriber actions and a well-maintained list; (2) Identification - Wix Email Marketing automatically adds 5 DNS records (3 sendgrid.net keys and 2 ascendbywix.com keys) to validate your campaign when using a custom mailbox; (3) Email Content - ensure subject lines are informative (not clickbait), content is relevant and proofread, and your business name/address are clearly identified in the footer. Follow these best practices: only email subscribers who have consented (use double opt-in), build your list organically (never purchase lists), regularly clean your list by removing inactive subscribers and bounced addresses, keep your audience engaged with relevant content, and gradually increase sending volume to warm up your list. If issues persist after reviewing these factors, contact Wix support for further assistance.

The 14-day money-back guarantee does not apply to plan renewals. According to Wix's refund policy, the 14-day refund period only applies to new Premium or Studio plans, not to renewals or upgrades of existing plans. Since your plan auto-renewed, you are not eligible for the automatic full refund under the 14-day policy. However, if you believe you still deserve a refund, you can contact Wix Customer Care and they will review your request on a case-by-case basis.

To get your site indexed and improve SEO: 1) Check if your site is indexed by searching 'site:yourdomain.com' in Google. 2) Ensure your site is published, as unpublished pages and changes won't be indexed. 3) Go to your SEO Dashboard > SEO Settings and make sure the 'Let search engines index your site' toggle is enabled. 4) Check that individual pages aren't blocked: verify no 'noindex' robots meta tag, remove any 301 redirects on the page, reset custom canonical tags to default, and ensure the page isn't password protected. 5) Ensure pages have at least 250-400 words of content. 6) Add internal links between pages to help search engines understand your site structure. 7) Complete the Wix SEO Setup Checklist, which submits your site and sitemap directly to Google for indexing. 8) Use Google Search Console or Wix Site Inspection to check index status and any manual actions. 9) Follow Google's E-E-A-T guidelines (Experience, Expertise, Authority, Trustworthiness) and quality guidelines. Note that it can take time for Google to crawl and index your site, and indexing does not guarantee a high ranking—ongoing content updates, relevant keywords, and backlinks help improve visibility over time.

If your company details documents were denied, ensure they meet these requirements: The tax ID/registration number must be visible and clear; the company name must be visible, clear, and match the business details in your Wix Payments account; the document must have been issued within the last 12 months; and it must be in HEIC, JPEG, JPG, PDF, or PNG format (max 10 MB, min 1 kB for PDF / 100 kB for other formats). Additionally, your company's name and registration number/tax ID must match the company's registered information, and the Legal Business Name and VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN entered in the form must match those associated with your business bank account. Upload a document that proves the validity and ownership of the VAT ID/Business ID/Tax ID/EIN during registration. If your business name changed, upload the current business registration document plus official name change documentation showing both the original and new legal business name.

To allow clients to book tours and accept payments, you must upgrade your site to a Premium plan that supports Wix Bookings, such as a Business & eCommerce Premium Plan. You can add Wix Bookings to your site for free, but bookings and online payments are only enabled after upgrading. To upgrade: go to your site's dashboard, click Upgrade, select the plan that suits your needs, choose your subscription period, click Continue to Checkout, enter your payment details, and click Submit Purchase. If you already have a site plan that doesn't support Wix Bookings, you can upgrade to one that does; if the new plan costs more, you pay only the difference in price.

Billing for Google Ads with Wix works through a monthly subscription model combined with ad credits. You pay a monthly subscription (billed before VAT) that covers all campaigns; this amount is applied directly to your ad credit each month. Wix retains 15% of your payment as a fee for running and optimizing campaigns, while the remaining 85% goes toward your ad credit. Ad credit is spent using a pay-per-click (PPC) model—you only pay when users click your ad links or CTA buttons. You can also set a daily spend limit per campaign (paid up front from your ad credit bucket) and make one-time payments to purchase additional ad credits. If you pay in a supported currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY), your ad credits remain in that currency; otherwise, they are converted to USD. New advertisers may qualify for Google's promotional credit (e.g., $500 USD) after spending $500 on ad clicks within the first 60 days. Invoices are available in your account's Billing History page.

To require customers to sign up before placing orders, restrict access to the Cart Page so only signed-in members can access it. First, ensure the Wix Members Area is added to your site. Then, in your editor, go to Pages & Menu, navigate to your Cart Page (under Store Pages for Wix Stores, Bookings Pages for Wix Bookings, or Cart & Thank You for Wix Restaurants Orders (New) or multiple solutions), click the Settings icon, select the Permissions tab, and click 'Members Only'. You can then choose to allow 'All members' or limit access to 'Only selected members or paying customers' (specific member roles or pricing plan purchasers). Note that some checkout methods like 'Buy Now' buttons may bypass the Cart Page, so restricting the Cart Page won't block those specific flows.

Different browsers and devices use different rendering engines, which can cause default fonts to render differently on mobile (and differently between iOS and Android). If you are experiencing an issue with one of the default fonts, Wix recommends choosing another similar looking font for your site. If you are on an iOS device, you can check iosfonts.com to verify whether the specific font is supported. If a supported, default font is not appearing on your mobile device, contact Wix support for assistance.

Wix offers four 2-step verification methods: (1) Wix app - approve login requests on a device already logged into the Wix mobile app; (2) SMS - receive a 6-digit code by text message; (3) Authenticator app - scan a QR code and enter a 6-digit code from an authenticator app; and (4) Email - receive a 6-digit code via email (only common domains like Gmail, Outlook, Hotmail are supported). You can enable multiple methods simultaneously; if so, the default prompt order is Wix app first, then authenticator app, then SMS, then email. To enable, go to Account Settings > 2-Step verification and click Enable next to your preferred method. When signing in from an unrecognized device, you'll confirm via your chosen method. By default, Wix remembers your device for 30 days. Note: Social logins (Google, Facebook) do not require a 2-step code. If using email verification, ensure your email address is confirmed in Account Settings first. We recommend setting up a Recovery Phone Number before enabling 2-step verification.

To cancel within the 14-day money-back period: Go to Premium Subscriptions in your Wix account, click the More Actions icon next to the relevant plan, click Cancel Plan, then click Cancel Now to confirm. If you cancel within the first 14 days, your plan ends immediately and you are fully refunded (allow up to 20 business days for the refund to appear).

To create a 'Buy 3 hats, get 20% off' discount, create an automatic discount with a minimum quantity requirement: Go to Automatic Discounts in your site's dashboard, click Create Discount, enter a discount name, select Specific categories (or Specific products) under 'What does this discount apply to?' and choose the hats category, check the 'Minimum quantity of items' checkbox and enter 3, select 'Percentage off' under 'What is the discount?' and enter 20%, then click Save.

You can access your site history from your Editor or your site's dashboard. In the Wix Editor: Click Site on the top of the Editor, then click Site History, then click Go to Site History. In the Wix Studio Editor: Click the Wix Studio logo on the top left, click Site, then click Site History. From your site's dashboard: Go to Site & App, scroll down and click Site History. Once there, you can browse through recent revisions to see who made changes and when, and you can restore a previous version by clicking the Arrow icon next to the version you want, reviewing it, and clicking Restore.

To clear your browser cache: First, close all windows and tabs of your browser and open a new tab ensuring Wix.com is not open. Then follow the steps for your specific browser:

**Chrome:** Press Ctrl + Shift + Del (Cmd + Shift + Delete on Mac). Click the drop-down next to Time range and select All time. Check the box next to Cached images and files. Click Clear data. Close and reopen Chrome.

**Firefox:** Press Ctrl + Shift + Del (Cmd + Shift + Delete on Mac). Click the drop-down next to Time range to clear and select Everything. Check the box next to Cache. Click Clear now. Close and reopen Firefox.

**Safari:** Press Cmd + , to open Preferences. Click the Advanced tab. Check the box next to Show Develop menu in menu bar. Click Develop in Safari's menu bar, then click Empty Caches. Close and reopen Safari.

**Edge:** Press Ctrl + Shift + Del (Cmd + Shift + Delete on Mac). Make sure the box is checked next to Cached data and files and click Clear. Close and reopen Microsoft Edge.

Yes. According to the documentation, you can start accepting payments on your site using Wix Payments almost immediately, even while your account is still under verification. When your account status is 'Accepting Payments', customers can complete their purchases on your site, but you cannot yet receive payouts to your bank account until the verification process is complete (which may take up to 7 business days).

Yes, you purchase the yearly Premium plan first. The free domain voucher is automatically included with the initial purchase of selected yearly or multi-year Premium plans, but it does not appear at the plan checkout. After purchasing the plan, go to the Premium Vouchers page in your Wix account to view and claim your voucher. The voucher is then applied when you purchase a new domain (go to Domains > Buy a Domain), not during the plan purchase itself. The voucher is valid for 2 months from the date you purchased your plan.

Wix Stores is designed for selling physical and digital products, not services. According to the documentation, Wix Stores allows you to 'Sell your own physical or digital products' and supports dropshipping, digital products, subscriptions, and gift cards, but does not list services as a product type. Services are mentioned separately in Wix's general business solutions as 'provide services and take bookings,' indicating they are handled through different Wix features rather than the Wix Stores catalog.

You can add discounts to your pricing plans by creating discount coupons. Go to Pricing Plans in your site's dashboard, click the More Actions icon at the top, and select Create a coupon. Choose between a fixed monetary discount ($ Discount) or a percentage discount (% Discount), enter a coupon code and name, then select whether the coupon applies to all plans or a specific plan. You can also choose whether the discount applies to the first billing cycle only, all billing cycles, or a custom number of cycles. Clients redeem the coupon code at checkout to receive the discounted price. Note that discount coupons cover the plans themselves but not any setup fees.

To change the order of items in your CMS collection and have it apply to your live site, follow these steps: 1) Go to CMS in your site's dashboard (or click CMS in your editor, then Your Collections). 2) Click the relevant collection and select the view at the top you want to use. 3) Choose how to sort: either add a sort condition (click Sort > + Add a Sort, select the field and order, then Add Sort) OR manually reorder items (make sure Table is selected as the layout type, click the Reorder icon next to an item, and drag it up or down). 4) Click Mirror on Site at the top of the collection and enable the toggle next to 'Mirror item order on the site'. Important troubleshooting notes: If the steps didn't work, check that you don't have any sort conditions added to your datasets, because dataset sorts override the order set in your mirrored collection view. Also note that manual reordering only works when Table layout is selected, and the Mirror on Site feature cannot be enabled for external collections or Wix Blocks collections. If you deleted a collection view that had mirroring enabled, the site order reverts to creation order.

To sync an external calendar (iCal) into Wix Hotels so visitors can book only available dates: 1) Locate your iCal URL from the external service (it must allow iCal export). 2) Go to your Wix dashboard and click the Hotels tab. 3) Expand the Reservations tab and select iCal. 4) Click the Choose Type drop-down and select a room type. 5) Paste your iCal URL into the URL field. 6) (Optional) Click Add Calendar to add another room type and paste its iCal URL. 7) Click Save. Notes: the sync is one-way only (from the external iCal to the Wix Calendar); imported rates do not appear in the calendar; if you have multiple room types you must add a different iCal URL for each; this feature is not compatible with the Wix Hotels Channel Manager—if you want to connect the Channel Manager, delete all URLs in this tab first.

Since your domain is connected to Wix via pointing, your domain host (not Wix) is in control of your domain's DNS records. You must add the Google Workspace TXT verification record with your domain host. Log in to your domain host account where your DNS records are managed and add the TXT record provided by Google (from the Google Admin Console verification steps) to your DNS settings there. Do not attempt to add it in your Wix account, as Wix cannot manage DNS records for domains connected via pointing.

Since you have a Recovery Phone Number added to your Wix account, you can recover your account using SMS verification. Go to the Wix Log In page and click 'Forgot Email?'. Select 'Can't access my login email' and click Next. Enter the email address associated with your Wix account and click Next. Select 'Send me a code to my phone number ending with XXXX' and click Next. Enter the one-time verification code sent to your phone under 'Enter code here' and click Verify. Then enter a new password, retype it, and click 'Save New Password'. After recovering your account, you should change the email address to one you can access.

PayPal availability depends on your business location/region. As of March 7, 2022, Wix no longer supports PayPal for businesses based in Russia. Even after adjusting your business location in the dashboard (top right drop-down), PayPal may not appear if it is not supported in your selected region. Go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard, verify the business location shown at the top right is correct, and if PayPal still isn't listed, click 'See More Payment Options' at the bottom to view all providers available in your location. PayPal is supported in over 200 countries, but not all regions.

Since you have a Google Workspace Admin account, you can reset the second account's password as an admin: Sign in to your Google Admin account, click Password, then Reset Password. Choose to automatically generate the password or enter a new one (minimum 8 characters by default). Optionally click Preview to view it, enable 'Ask for a password change at the next sign-in' if you want the user to change it, then click Reset. You can then click 'Click to copy password' to paste it somewhere, or choose to email the password to the user, then click Done.

According to the documentation, if pages you created in the editor are not appearing on your live site after publishing: 1) Confirm you clicked Publish at the top right of the editor (clicking Save alone does not make changes live). 2) If you connected a custom domain to your site, it may take up to 48 hours for the site to appear when accessing that domain due to propagation. 3) If the pages are missing from your site menu, note that the menu automatically displays every page except those you've hidden; ensure your header and footer are not hidden (if the menu is attached to them or set to show on all pages). 4) If the issue persists, follow the steps in the Wix Technical Assistant to resolve the issue.

If you haven't received your Wix Payments payout in your bank account yet, first confirm your Wix Payments account status is Active (go to Accept Payments in your site's dashboard) — payouts are only sent when the account is verified and Active, with an available balance of at least $1. Each payment goes through processing (usually 2-5 business days, including a 1-2 day settlement and a 2-5 business day pending period), then is added to your next scheduled daily/weekly/monthly payout, and once the payout status is Sent it should arrive in your bank account within 3-5 business days (timing can vary by day of week, currency, and bank holidays). Your first payout is typically available within an average of 7 days after your first payment, then takes an average of 3-5 business days to reach your bank. You can view previous and upcoming payouts and their status by going to Payouts in your site's dashboard and clicking the relevant payout. If a payout failed, verify your bank details under Account Details and confirm your bank account can receive EFT payments (ACH transfers in the US); correct/resubmit the details if needed, and the funds will be included in your next scheduled payout.

To create custom hours for a staff member: On desktop, go to Staff in your site's dashboard, hover over the relevant staff member and click Edit, then click Add Working Hours. Select a Start Date, optionally set an end date for temporary hours, choose the Repeats frequency (e.g., Weekly), select the relevant days of the week, enter start and end times, choose the Location, and click Save. On the Wix app, tap Manage > Booking Calendar > Staff tab, select the staff member, tap Add Hours next to Working Hours, then follow the same steps to set the date, recurrence, days, times, and location before tapping Save. You can repeat these steps to add multiple custom hour blocks for the same staff member.

To enable guest checkout for your pricing plans: Go to Pricing Plans Settings in your site's dashboard (or go to Settings, then click Pricing Plans Settings). Click the Checkout tab at the top. Enable the Guest checkout toggle to let visitors buy a plan without signing up or logging in. Click Save. Note: Guest checkout is only available for plans that do not include online content and services, and it is only available to customers on the Plans & Pricing page on your site.

You can manage your Wix Bookings categories from the Booking Services tab in your site's dashboard. To create a category: go to Booking Services, click Manage Categories, click + Add New Category, enter the Category Name, and click Add. To assign a service to a category, select the service, click the Service category drop-down, choose the relevant category, and click Save (note: a service can only be in one category at a time). To reorder categories, click Manage Categories and drag the handle next to each category; to reorder services, select a category from the drop-down and drag services within that category (you cannot reorder services in the 'All categories' view). To rename a category, hover over it in Manage Categories and click Edit Name. To delete a category, hover over it in Manage Categories, click Delete, then choose either to move its services to another category (select the new category and click Move & Delete) or to permanently delete the category and its services (this cannot be undone). You can also filter your Service List by category using the Categories drop-down and customize which columns are visible via the Customize columns icon next to the search bar.

To block off time slots for a single staff member: 1) Go to Booking Calendar in your site's dashboard. 2) Click Add or click the time slot you wish to block off on the calendar. 3) Select Blocked Time. 4) Choose the specific staff member from the Staff drop-down menu. 5) (Optional) Enter a Title to explain the reason. 6) Select a start date and time. 7) Select an end date and time. 8) (Optional) Add a note for yourself. 9) Click Block. During these blocked time slots, customers will not be able to book appointments with that staff member.

To delete items from a CMS collection: 1) Go to CMS in your site's dashboard. 2) Click the relevant collection. 3) Select the checkbox next to the item(s) you want to delete. To select multiple items at once, select the first item, hold down the Shift key, and select the last item. 4) Click Delete. 5) Click Delete again to confirm. Important: If you have the optional Sandbox enabled and the content exists in both Sandbox and Live collections, you must delete the item in both locations (syncing Sandbox does not remove it from Live). Before deleting, ensure no dynamic pages or references in another collection are connected to the item, as these links will break once the item is deleted.

Order confirmation emails from Wix Stores are sent to the email address set in the Business Info section of your site's settings. To set or change it: go to the Business Info section of your site's settings, scroll down to the Location & Contact Info section, and enter the email address in the Email field. You can change that email address at any time. Note: the documentation describes a single Email field in Business Info (used for contact info and shown in places like Wix Chat and Wix Invoices); it does not describe separate email fields for order confirmations versus general inquiries, so based on the retrieved docs both would use the Business Info email unless another feature (e.g., Wix Automations) is used for additional notifications.

To add funds to your Wix Payments account in order to issue a refund, start the refund process first. On desktop: Go to Payments in your site's dashboard, select the payment to refund, click Refund, enter the amount (and optional note), then click Refund and confirm. If you need to add funds, click 'Add Funds & Complete Refund', enter your credit/debit card details, and click 'Add Funds & Complete Refund'. On the Wix app: Go to Payments, tap the payment to refund, tap Refund, enter the amount (and optional note), tap Issue Refund and confirm. If you need to add funds, tap 'Add Funds & Complete Refund', enter the amount of funds to add and tap Continue, enter your payment details, and tap Add Funds. Once the funds are processed, the refund to your customer is issued automatically. Note: To add more than $20,000, contact Wix Customer Care.

It is not possible to edit or modify a domain name once it has been purchased. To change your domain to one that does not include "DBT", you must register a new domain name and connect it to your site. Additionally, since domains purchased through Wix renew automatically, you should turn off the auto-renewal option for the current domain to avoid being charged for another year.
After you list your products on Google Merchant Solutions, it can take up to 72 hours (3 days) for Google to approve them before they can appear in your campaign.

To change the order of products in a category: Go to Categories in your site's dashboard, select the relevant category, click and drag the products to change their order, then click Save. This changes the order on your site wherever that category is displayed. Note: If you're using a Category Page, you can override this order by clicking the Category Page in your editor, clicking Settings, selecting the Sorting tab, and choosing a different option from the 'Order products by' drop-down.

Yes, for an individual Wix Payments account, additional information is required during verification. You must upload a color copy of a valid government-issued photo ID and a bank statement to your Wix Payments Dashboard. You also need to provide a physical address (PO Boxes not accepted) along with an address verification document such as a utility bill issued within the last 6 months, and complete your Business Description including your Doing Business As name, Business Type, and a short description of your products/services. Ensure your first/middle/last name and date of birth match your photo ID, and that your bank account number(s) are entered correctly. Verification may take up to 7 business days.

To determine if more information is required, check your account status in your site's dashboard under Accept Payments. If your Wix Payments status is 'Accepting Payments' (rather than 'Active'), your account setup/verification is not yet complete and you cannot yet receive payouts.
